verdict.rationale: Trivy docs confirm secret scanning across container images, filesystem, and git repository targets, enabled by default, covering passwords, API keys, and tokens (trivy-docs-3, trivy-docs-10). However, the evidence does not explicitly confirm scanning of the FULL git history (commit-by-commit) versus just the current working tree/latest commit state, which is central to the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of full git-history secret scanning (all past commits, not just current checkout), independent hands-on confirmation of historical-commit secret detection, and details on performance/output for large repo histories.
